source.title: Appointment of New Committee/Team Leaders (November 2017)
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

There will be four appointments of new WCA Committee/Team Leaders. Daniel Sheppard and Linus Frész are stepping down as Leaders of the WCA Disciplinary Committee and the WCA Communication Team, respectively. Daniel and Linus have deployed great work as Leaders, and we want to thank them for all their hard work and dedication all this time.

The World Cube Association will also be adding two brand new Advisory Committees: the WCA Ethics Committee and the WCA Quality Assurance Committee. The Ethics Committee will have the role to ensure that all the procedures followed by the WCA Staff and External Staff abide by its Code of Ethics. Also, our large growing rate makes a Quality Assurance Committee necessary, with the role to support and promote continuous quality improvement within the WCA, as well as worldwide application of quality standards to ensure consistent high quality of processes, WCA Staff, Regional Organizations, Competition Organizers, and Competition Staff.
<!-- break -->

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to dedicate at least 6 hours per week on average to work for their respective Team/Committee. The qualities requested to candidates are:

WCA Disciplinary Committee (WDC):
Secrecy
Objective thinking
Fairness
Thoroughness

WCA Communication Team (WCT):
Social media knowledge
Fluent English
Communication skills
Patience

WCA Ethics Committee (WEC):
Clear background
Trustworthiness
Independence
Accountability

WCA Quality Assurance Committee (WQAC):
Accuracy
Very good knowledge of the regulations
Practical thinking
Team work

The application period is open for candidates to submit their candidacy documents. **Candidacy documents must be sent from now until November 28th, 2017, 23:59 UTC** privately to:
WCA Disciplinary Committee: Ron van Bruchem (cubefool@gmail.com)
WCA Communication Team: Luis J. Iáñez (luisjianez@gmail.com)
WCA Ethics Committee: Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol (albertopdrf.wca@gmail.com)
WCA Quality Assurance Committee: Olivér Perge (pergeoliver@gmail.com )

Recipients will confirm the documents are in good order or will report on deficiencies otherwise once received. The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and they must include:
Application Committee/Team
Brief personal introduction
Summary of activities done for the WCA
Ambitions as Leader of the Committee/Team

The rights and duties of WDC, WCT, WEC, and WQAC from our By-laws can be found [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jhfRE_vnMt7-lMfl3LEmCxTVIByWeHktaJbKn6R4p20/edit?usp=sharing).

The week after the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting. Selected winners will be presented to the WCA Seniors for their approval. Finally, the new Leaders will be announced.

Thanks for your candidacies and support!

(Posted by Lauren Clement on behalf of the World Cube Association)

translation.title: 招募新一届委员会与团队负责人（2017 年 11 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 将任命四位新的委员会或团队负责人。Daniel Sheppard 和 Linus Frész 将分别卸任 WCA 纪律委员会及 WCA 通讯组负责人。两人在任内做了出色的工作，感谢他们一直以来的努力与投入。

世界魔方协会还将新增两个咨询委员会：WCA 道德委员会和 WCA 质量保证委员会。道德委员会将确保 WCA 工作人员及外部工作人员遵循的所有程序符合《道德准则》。随着协会快速发展，我们也需要设立质量保证委员会，支持并推动 WCA 持续改善工作质量，在全球应用质量标准，确保流程、WCA 工作人员、地区组织、比赛主办方及工作人员始终保持较高水准。

候选人应完成整个任期（24 个月），平均每周至少投入 6 小时处理所属团队或委员会的工作。各职位的要求如下：

WCA 纪律委员会（WDC）：

- 能严守秘密。
- 客观思考。
- 公正。
- 做事细致周全。

WCA 通讯组（WCT）：

- 了解社交媒体。
- 英语流利。
- 良好的沟通能力。
- 有耐心。

WCA 道德委员会（WEC）：

- 无不良记录。
- 值得信赖。
- 能独立判断。
- 有责任心。

WCA 质量保证委员会（WQAC）：

- 做事准确。
- 非常熟悉规则。
- 注重实际。
- 善于团队合作。

现开放提交申请材料。**请于即日起至 2017 年 11 月 28 日 23:59 UTC**，将材料私下发送给对应联系人：

- WCA 纪律委员会：Ron van Bruchem（cubefool@gmail.com）。
- WCA 通讯组：Luis J. Iáñez（luisjianez@gmail.com）。
- WCA 道德委员会：Alberto Pérez de Rada Fiol（albertopdrf.wca@gmail.com）。
- WCA 质量保证委员会：Olivér Perge（pergeoliver@gmail.com）。

收到材料后，联系人会确认材料是否齐全，如有缺漏会告知申请者。申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：

- 申请的委员会或团队。
- 简短的个人介绍。
- 曾为 WCA 开展的工作概述。
- 担任该委员会或团队负责人后的工作设想。

章程中 WDC、WCT、WEC 和 WQAC 的权利与职责可在[这里](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1jhfRE_vnMt7-lMfl3LEmCxTVIByWeHktaJbKn6R4p20/edit?usp=sharing)查看。

申请期结束后的下一周，WCA 董事会将投票选出人选，并提交 WCA 高级代表批准。之后将公布新负责人名单。

感谢大家的申请与支持！

（Lauren Clement 代表世界魔方协会发布）
